hero.title: Colophon
hero.description: A colophon is a note on how a work was made - the fonts, the tools, the little decisions. Here's a peek behind the curtain of this site.

intro.paragraph1: This site is a single-page Vue app, built with a component-first mindset: small, reusable pieces (buttons, inputs, cards) composed into full pages, all backed by a typed API layer and cached with TanStack Query.
intro.paragraph2: Every screen ships in both English and Indonesian, adapts to light and dark mode, and respects your device's reduced-motion setting - the entrance animations you see are a nice-to-have, never a requirement to read the content.

highlights.typedAndCached: Typed API layer, cached with TanStack Query

typography.title: Typography
typography.sans: for headings and body copy - clean, geometric, and easy to scan
typography.mono: for code, dates, and anything that benefits from fixed-width alignment

palette.title: Color Palette
palette.description: The accent colors throughout this site are drawn from Ikuyo Kita of Kessoku Band: red hair, green-yellow eyes, a gold uniform button, and a maroon ribbon and shoes.

craft.title: Motion & Accessibility
craft.description: Theme switching crossfades with the View Transitions API instead of animating every element by hand, and scroll/entrance animations fall back to an instant, motion-free state whenever prefers-reduced-motion is on.

source.title: Open Source
source.description: Curious how it's put together under the hood? The full source code is public on GitHub, from the component library down to the color tokens above.
